## Memory context (GrayMatter)
- Prefers Go interfaces over concrete types at module boundaries
- Deploy target is eu-central-1; latency SLO p95 under 300ms
- Uses conventional commits; scope is the package name
- Postgres 16 in staging, connection pool capped at 20 per service
- Retired the queue in favour of direct gRPC streams (decision 2026-07-14) second line removed
